acceptanceCriteria: Given no cart exists, When the caller creates a cart with currency code EUR, Then a cart is returned with an assigned id and currency code EUR
Given no cart exists, When the caller creates a cart without a currency code, Then the command is rejected with a required-field error on currencyCode
Given no cart exists, When the caller creates a cart with an inline billing address and shipping address, Then the cart is returned with both addresses attached
Given no cart exists, When the caller creates a cart with an inline line item (title, quantity, unit price), Then the cart is returned with that line item in its items collection
Given a cart exists, When the caller adds a line item with title, quantity 1 and unit price 100, Then the cart contains exactly one line item with those values
Given a cart id that does not exist, When the caller adds a line item, Then the command is rejected with a not-found error
Given a cart exists, When the caller adds a line item missing quantity, Then the command is rejected with a required-field error on quantity
Given a line item exists, When the caller updates its title, Then the new title is returned
Given several line items exist across carts, When the caller updates them in one call, Then every matching line item is updated
Given a line item exists on a cart, When the caller removes it, Then the cart items collection no longer contains it
Given multiple line items exist on a cart, When the caller removes them all, Then the cart items collection is empty
Given a cart exists, When the caller sets a shipping address on the cart, Then the cart reflects that shipping address
Given a shipping address is attached to a cart, When the caller updates first name on the address, Then the cart shipping address reflects the new first name
Given a cart exists, When the caller sets a billing address on the cart, Then the cart reflects that billing address
Given a cart exists, When the caller adds a shipping method with name and amount 100, Then the method appears on the cart
Given a cart exists, When the caller adds a shipping method with a negative amount, Then the command is rejected
Given a cart has a shipping method, When the caller removes it, Then the cart has no shipping methods
Given a cart has line items, When the caller sets adjustments for each line item, Then those adjustments are present
Given a cart already has a line-item adjustment, When the caller sets a different adjustment for the same line item, Then only the new adjustment remains
Given a cart has line-item adjustments, When the caller sets the adjustments to an empty list, Then all adjustments on all line items are removed
Given a cart has a line-item adjustment with id A, When the caller sets adjustments containing id A with changed fields, Then the adjustment with id A is updated in place
Given a cart has shipping methods, When the caller sets adjustments for each shipping method, Then those adjustments are present
Given a cart has shipping-method adjustments, When the caller sets them to empty, Then all are removed

Given a shipping method belongs to cart A, When the caller tries to add an adjustment for that method against cart B, Then the command is rejected because the shipping method does not belong to cart B
Given a cart has line items, When the caller sets tax lines per item (code, rate), Then those tax lines are present
Given a cart has line-item tax lines, When the caller sets them to empty, Then all are removed

Given a cart has two tax lines on one item, When the caller sets a list with one updated existing id and one new tax line, Then the updated line is updated, the new line is created, and the omitted line is removed
Given a cart has shipping methods, When the caller sets tax lines per method, Then those tax lines are present
Given a cart has shipping tax lines, When the caller sets them to empty, Then all are removed
Given a cart exists, When the caller adds a credit line referencing a refund or gift card, Then the credit line appears on the cart
Given a cart has a credit line, When the caller removes it, Then the credit line is no longer on the cart
Given a cart exists, When the caller updates the cart's email, Then the cart is returned with the new email
Given no cart with a given id exists, When the caller updates that id, Then the command is rejected with a not-found error
Given a cart exists, When the caller deletes it, Then it is no longer listed for that id
Given a cart was soft-deleted, When the caller restores it, Then the cart is available again under its id

ListCarts.description: Admin/customer listing of existing carts before creation, with filters for customer, status, region.

GetCart.description: Full cart with all related entities and computed totals projection (Section 9 of the cart-aggregate spec).

fields.name: itemTotal
fields.description: Sum of line-item totals after discounts

fields.name: total
fields.description: Final payable amount (items + shipping + tax − discounts − credit lines)

fields.name: currencyCode
fields.description: ISO-4217 currency code (lowercase). Fixed at creation.

fields.name: regionId
fields.description: External reference to the Region aggregate

fields.name: customerId
fields.description: External reference to the Customer aggregate

fields.name: salesChannelId
fields.description: External reference to the Sales Channel aggregate

fields.name: completedAt
fields.description: Set externally when the cart becomes an order; marker field at the aggregate boundary

fields.name: billingAddress
fields.description: Billing address value object on the cart

fields.name: shippingAddress
fields.description: Shipping address value object on the cart

fields.name: shippingMethods
fields.description: Shipping methods selected for the cart

fields.name: creditLines
fields.description: Credit lines applied to the cart (refunds, gift cards)

fields.name: title
fields.description: Display title of the line item

fields.name: unitPrice
fields.description: Price per unit at the moment of the operation (bigNumber)

fields.name: variantId
fields.description: Snapshot reference to the Product variant

fields.name: requiresShipping
fields.description: Whether shipping applies to this line item

fields.name: isDiscountable
fields.description: Whether the item is eligible for promotions

fields.name: isGiftcard
fields.description: Whether the item is a gift-card line

fields.name: isCustomPrice
fields.description: Whether the price was set manually rather than from catalogue

fields.name: compareAtUnitPrice
fields.description: Original list price for strike-through display

fields.name: adjustments
fields.description: Discounts applied to this line item (set-replaced)

fields.name: taxLines
fields.description: Tax charges applied to this line item (set-replaced)

fields.name: name
fields.description: Display name of the shipping method

fields.name: shippingOptionId
fields.description: External reference to the Fulfillment shipping option

fields.name: adjustments
fields.description: Discounts applied to this shipping method (set-replaced)

fields.name: taxLines
fields.description: Tax charges applied to this shipping method (set-replaced)

fields.name: amount

fields.name: reference
